findings.label: onTargetChange prop mismatch
findings.detail: TradingWorkspace.tsx passes onTargetChange={setDigitTarget} to DemoTradeTicket, but DemoTradeTicket's Props type does not declare onTargetChange. This is a confirmed TypeScript error. Remove the prop from the JSX call site.

findings.label: dailyLossLimit zero silently disables loss protection
findings.detail: checkStopConditions guards with dailyLossLimit < 0, so a stored value of 0 never triggers the stop. loadConfig's Math.min(..., 0) clamp preserves 0. Map a loaded 0 to base.dailyLossLimit or add an explicit 'disabled' semantic.

findings.label: No upper bound on maxStake input
findings.detail: BotConfigForm has min=1 but no max on the maxStake field. Combined with martingale, arbitrarily large stakes can be submitted to Deriv. Add a max attribute or enforce a ceiling in nextStake.

findings.label: onmessage not restored on proposal/buy timeout paths
findings.detail: The proposal and buy Promise awaiters override socketRef.current.onmessage but restore it only on success. On timeout (resolve(null)), the override remains, leaving abandoned listeners on the socket. Restore onmessage in all timeout branches.

findings.label: Settlement onmessage not restored when stop() drains the promise
findings.detail: When stop() calls resolveSettlementRef.current(null), the settlement Promise resolves but the onmessage override is never restored. The socket stays live with the dangling handler until the next start() or unmount. Restore onmessage in the resolveSettlementRef.current(null) code path.
